descr:
---

name: Aquatic Elf Warrior
descr:
---

You have trained in the use of weapons both above and below water. You have familiarity with crossbows, heavy crossbows, daggers, longspears, spears, and tridents—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. You don’t take a –2 circumstance penalty to melee slashing or bludgeoning attacks while underwater.

name: Bitter Taste of Betrayal
descr:
**Archetype** [Pirate](/archetype/pirate-player-core-2)

**Prerequisites**
[Pirate Dedication](/feat/pirate-dedication-player-core-2)

**Access**
You're from the Shackles

---

Spend enough time in Hell Harbor, and you pick up the paranoia encouraged by Arronax Endymion. Maybe you served under him on the _Tyrannous_, escaped his executioners, or had a friend who wasn’t so lucky; whatever the reason, you have some of his wariness. Unless you’re a willing target, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saves against creatures you consider an ally and creatures who are [undetected](/condition/undetected-player-core) by you. If a creature you thought was an ally reveals itself as an enemy, you get the same bonus against them until the end of your next turn.

name: Bounce Boost
descr:
**Prerequisites**
Trained in Athletics

**Trigger**
An adjacent ally attempts to [High Jump](/action/high-jump-player-core) or [Long Jump](/action/long-jump-player-core).

---

You’ve learned to use your own athletic abilities and springy legs to help others who need a boost with their leaps. The triggering ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their Athletics check to High Jump or Long Jump. This bonus increases to +2 if you’re an expert in Athletics, +3 if you’re a master, and +4 if you’re legendary. Additionally, the triggering ally’s [Leap](/action/leap-player-core) distance on a successful check increases by 2 feet for a High Jump or 5 feet for a Long Jump, even if it would allow the ally to Leap further than their land Speed.

name: Bullet and a Broadside
descr:
_**PFS Note** Pathfinder Society does not use siege weaponry._

**Access**
You're from the Shackles

**Requirements**
You’re wielding a firearm or crossbow and are adjacent to a [siege weapon](/rule/siege-weapons-rules-1622).

---

You’re familiar with ranged weapons of all sizes, and can efficiently move to use them in tandem. If you spent one action, you [Launch](/rule/launching-rules-1626) the siege weapon and [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) with your firearm or crossbow in any order, using the same multiple attack penalty for both attacks. If you spent two actions, you [Load](/rule/loading-rules-1625) the siege engine and [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) to reload your firearm or crossbow in any order, and don’t need a free hand to do so.

name: Cannonball Fall
descr:
**Prerequisites**
Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics

**Access**
You're from the Shackles

**Requirements**
You are above an enemy.

---

You’ve learned how to make a quick descent with a sudden stop—directly on an enemy. You intentionally fall onto an enemy within 10 feet of you horizontally and can accurately target them from up to a height equal to 5 feet times your level. You take damage as [normal](/rule/falling-rules-2352); the enemy must attempt a Reflex save against your class DC with the following results, instead of the usual rules for [falling on a creature](/rule/falling-on-a-creature-rules-2353). If an ability reduces the amount of damage you take from falling, the enemy’s damage is based on the damage you would have taken before that reduction. In addition, if you have a means of controlling your descent, such as holding onto a rope or sliding down an adjacent wall, you do not land [prone](/condition/prone-player-core) even if you take damage from the fall.

**Critical Success** The enemy takes no damage.

**Success** The enemy takes bludgeoning damage equal to one quarter the falling damage you took.

**Failure** The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to half the falling damage you took and is knocked prone.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage you took from the fall, is knocked prone, and is [stunned](/condition/stunned-player-core) 1.

name: Coerce the Current
descr:
_**PFS Note** Can be used in less than 20 feet of water, ending its effect at the water line._

**Requirements**
You are swimming in water.

---

With a flick of your tail, you direct the water around you to move creatures. You move water in a 20-foot [line](/rule/line-rules-2388); this line must be entirely in water. Each creature in this line must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. A creature can choose to fail the save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [pushed](/rule/forced-movement-rules-2364) or pulled 5 feet in the direction of your choice. All creatures must be moved in the same direction.

**Failure** As success, but the creature is pushed or pulled 10 feet.

**Critical Failure** As success, but the creature is pushed or pulled 10 feet, and the creature is [off-guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core) until the end of your next turn.

name: Deadly Casework
descr:
_**PFS Note** Planning assassinations is anathema to the Pathfinder Society._

**Prerequisites**
member of the Red Mantis assassins

**Access**
member of the Red Mantis assassins

---

You can [Pursue a Lead](/action/pursue-a-lead-player-core-2) and open an [investigation](/rule/investigations-rules-2578) regarding a target you want to assassinate. name: Deduce Habits
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Plot the Future](/feat/plot-the-future-player-core-2)

**Access**
member of the Red Mantis assassins

---

When you use Plot the Future, you can instead contemplate a person that you’ve gotten to observe within 30 feet for at least 1 minute. You deduce places they will habitually be in the next week and what time of day they’ll be there. For each location, you deduce the likelihood that they will be two of the following: alone, unarmed, or unaware. You also gain a piece of advice for each location suggesting a course of action you or your allies could take that might make it more or less likely for them to be in the chosen states. The GM determines the locations the person will visit and when, as well as the likelihood they’ll be alone, unarmed, or unaware.

descr:

[Aquatic Elf](/heritage/aquatic-elf-high-seas-heritage-heritage-435) heritage

---

Your eyes have adapted to the rigors of the sea. If you didn’t already have [darkvision](/rule/darkvision-and-greater-darkvision-rules-2410), you gain darkvision. Additionally, you can see through natural phenomena that would obscure your vision underwater, such as cloudy waters, ink, smoke, and so forth, and don’t need to succeed at a [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) to target creature within these phenomena. Finally, you can cast [_truesight_](/spell/truesight-player-core) as a primal [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2232) once per day.

name: Frog Geyser
descr:
**Requirements**
Your mouth is full of water.

---

You can spray a powerful steam of water from your mouth to push your foes around. Filling your mouth with water for your stream requires using an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action while next to a source of at least 1 gallon of water. You can hold water in your mouth indefinitely, but while you do, you’re unable to speak. When you use Frog Geyser, you shoot water in a 20-foot [line](/rule/line-rules-2388). All creatures in the line must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [pushed](/rule/forced-movement-rules-2364) back 5 feet.

**Failure** The creature is pushed back 10 feet.

**Critical Failure** The creature is pushed back 10 feet and knocked [prone](/condition/prone-player-core).

name: Frog Tide
descr:
**Frequency**
once per day

---

You have a connection to water and are able to call upon it to batter your foes and carry them away. You create a massive wave of water that crashes in a 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385) within 120 feet that moves in the direction of your choice. All creatures in the area take 14d6 bludgeoning damage and could be swept away. At the beginning of subsequent turns for 3 rounds, the wave moves 30 feet in the direction you chose; creatures in the area who aren’t already swept away by the wave take the bludgeoning damage. Creatures being swept away are trapped within the wave and can attempt to Escape against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, to end the effect. Otherwise, the creature remains swept away until the wave stops moving. The wave also extinguishes all non-magical fires in its path automatically.

Creatures are affected based on the result of their Reflex saves with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is [moved](/rule/forced-movement-rules-2364) 10 feet in the direction of the wave, but not swept away.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is fully swept away by the wave. The creature moves along with the wave until it [Escapes](/action/escape-player-core).

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the creature takes double damage and must hold its breath or begin [suffocating](/rule/drowning-and-suffocating-rules-2439) (unless it can breathe in water).

name: Halyard Strike
descr:

You're from the Shackles

**Requirements**
A rope is within your reach, or you have a [rope](/item/rope-player-core) or [grappling](/trait/grapple) weapon in your hand.

---

You’ve learned to fight confidently while swinging from a line. You take hold of a nearby rope, throw a rope from your hand, or fire a grappling weapon at a solid surface, and then swing up to twice your Speed. You can make a [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) using a one-handed weapon or unarmed attack at any point during this movement. If you critically fail on this Strike, your movement ends at the point you attempted the Strike.

**Special** If you have [Pirate Dedication](/feat/pirate-dedication-player-core-2) and you boarded or disembarked from a boat or similar vehicle during this movement, the Strike deals one additional weapon damage die.

name: Inner Sea Privateer
descr:
**Archetype** [Pirate](/archetype/pirate-player-core-2)

**Prerequisites**
[Pirate Dedication](/feat/pirate-dedication-player-core-2); Expert in Sailing Lore

**Access**
You're from the Shackles

---

You make your living as a pirate, as well as a little extra by hiring out your services to Andoran, Cheliax, or Mbe’ke. You need to recognize which ships are legitimate targets and which you need to play nice with. You can use Sailing Lore to [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core) about creatures native to the High Seas and flags, ships, and sailors in the region. If a ship is using a false flag or other disguise to hide its true allegiances, the GM will roll a secret Sailing Lore check for you to recognize it, typically against a standard DC for the level of the ship’s captain.

name: Into the Storm
descr:

**Prerequisites**
[Pirate Dedication](/feat/pirate-dedication-player-core-2)

**Access**

---

Many Shackles pirates use the Eye of Abendego to great effect, but none have more familiarity with the storm than the Master of the Gales, ruler of Drenchport and five-time winner of the Free Captains’ Regatta. You’ve learned his crew’s techniques for fighting in severe weather. You reduce circumstance penalties to ranged weapon attacks due to wind or precipitation by 2. You can also use weapons you’re a master in with a –4 circumstance penalty (–2 if you’re legendary) even if wind or precipitation would normally prevent it, such as the effects of [_wall of wind_](/spell/wall-of-wind-player-core).

name: Marine Marauder Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [Marine Marauder](/archetype/marine-marauder-high-seas-archetype-archetype-385)

**Prerequisites**

---

You’re as skilled in combat underwater as on land. You gain the [Underwater Marauder](/feat/underwater-marauder-player-core) skill feat, and when you roll a success on an Athletics check to [Swim](/action/swim-player-core), you get a critical success instead. In addition, checks to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core) or [Force Open](/action/force-open-player-core) nets you use are attempted against your class DC instead of the listed DC, and you can keep hold of a target you’ve grappled with a net with one hand.

name: Personalized Poisoning
descr:
_**PFS Note** Requires cross-scenario tracking._

**Prerequisites**
alchemical sciences methodology

**Access**
member of the Red Mantis assassins

---

You developed techniques for discovering a target’s weaknesses to poisons using your forensic knowledge. When you study a location that a creature spends a lot of time in, such as a bedroom or office, you learn medical conditions, reactions, or sensitivities that make them susceptible to poisons. Subsequently, whenever you craft an [alchemical poison](/rule/alchemical-poisons-rules-3185), you can tailor it to a creature you have studied in this way, giving that creature a –2 circumstance penalty to Fortitude saves against the poison and giving other creatures a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against it.

name: Pirate's Pet
descr:
**Archetype** [Pirate](/archetype/pirate-player-core-2)

**Prerequisites**
[Pirate Dedication](/feat/pirate-dedication-player-core-2)

**Access**

---

An animal has become your loyal ally, perhaps after you liberated it from another ship or found it on a remote island. You gain the [Pet](/feat/pet-player-core) general feat. Your pet gains an additional pet Shackles Options ability, which you can choose from the standard pet abilities or the following familiar abilities: accompanist, damage avoidance, independent, partner in crime, speech, and valet.

In addition, you learn a common 1st- or 2nd-rank spell that targets your familiar, and can cast it once per day as a primal [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2232). You can instead learn [_phase familiar_](/spell/phase-familiar-player-core) and can cast it once per hour as a primal innate spell; it’s not a focus spell for you. When you cast the chosen spell, you target your pirate’s pet instead of a familiar.

You served on nephilim pirate Ila “Sharkskin” Clare’s ship, the _Scorched Shark_, and have adopted xir practice of embellishing clothing and armor with sharkskin. As long as you’re wearing your clothing, you gain a +1 item bonus to unarmed attack rolls, Acrobatics checks, and Reflex saves and DCs to Escape, Grab an Edge, or avoid falling prone. In addition, when you successfully Grapple a creature, you deal slashing damage equal to your fist damage dice to that creature as you abrade their skin.

When you cast these spells, you do so by performing haunting songs; each spell gains the [auditory](/trait/auditory) trait.

**Prerequisites**

---

You topple your foes with your legs and attack them while they’re down. You [Trip](/action/trip-player-core) a creature within reach without needing a free hand. If you succeed, you can make a melee [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) against that creature. Your multiple attack penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made both the Trip and Strike.

name: Steal for the Depths
descr:
**Requirements**
You are swimming in water at least 10 feet deep.

---

You reach out and grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface. Attempt an Athletics check to [Grapple](/action/grapple-player-core) the creature. On a success, if the creature is on land, in addition to the normal effects of Grapple, you pull the creature into the water in a space adjacent to you. If the creature is already in the water, on a success, in addition the normal effects of Grapple, you drag the creature 10 feet deeper into the water, moving 10 feet with the creature. Moving a creature into water or deeper into water using Steal for the Depths is [forced movement](/rule/forced-movement-rules-2364) for the creature but not for you.

descr:
**Frequency**
once per day

---

With a mix of magic and physical training, you have learned to render yourself [invisible](/condition/invisible-player-core) while hiding underwater. You mimic the subtle movement of water so as not to disturb its surface, and you change your skin color to blend in with your surroundings. You gain the effects of [_invisibility_](/spell/invisibility-player-core) for up to 1 hour, as long as you remain submerged.

name: Swan Dive
descr:
**Access**
You're from the Shackles

---

You soar through the air and into the water, using your momentum to propel yourself forward. You intentionally [Leap](/action/leap-player-core) or otherwise fall into a body of water, taking no falling damage regardless of the distance, and then [Swim](/action/swim-player-core) up to your Speed. Until the end of your turn, when you roll a success on an Athletics check to Swim you get a critical success instead, and when you roll a critical failure you get a failure instead.

name: Swimming Charge
descr:
_**PFS Note** Add the [Attack](/trait/attack) trait to Swimming Charge._

**Requirements**
You are swimming in water.

---

You swim directly into a foe, attempting to push them out of the way. [Swim](/action/swim-player-core) up to your Speed, attempting to enter the space of a foe that’s your size or smaller. Roll an Athletics check and compare the result of the Fortitude DC of the target creature. If the foe can’t move into an empty space (if it is surrounded by solid objects or other creatures, for example), you automatically critically fail this check.

**Critical Success** The target takes bludgeoning damage equal to your level plus twice your Strength modifier and must move into the empty space directly behind it; you move into the space it vacated. The target must move even if doing so places it in harm’s way.

**Success** As critical success, but the damage is equal to your level plus your Strength modifier.

**Failure** The target takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier and you end your movement before entering its space.

**Critical Failure** The target is unaffected and you end your movement before entering its space.

name: Take in the Catch
descr:
**Archetype** [Marine Marauder](/archetype/marine-marauder-high-seas-archetype-archetype-385)

**Prerequisites**
[Marine Marauder Dedication](/feat/marine-marauder-dedication-high-seas-feat-feat-9030)

**Requirements**
You’re holding a [net](/item/net-player-core).

---

Your skills in marine fishing can also be applied to combat. Attempt to [Grapple](/action/grapple-player-core) a creature with your net, with the normal results. Then you [Step](/action/step-player-core), [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) to draw a weapon, and [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) the creature you attempted to grapple. If you succeeded on your check to Grapple, the creature remains [grabbed](/condition/grabbed-player-core) after your Step.

name: Think Twice
descr:
**Prerequisites**
Expert in Intimidation

**Access**
You're from the Shackles

**Trigger**
A creature that’s [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) targets you with an attack.

---

You make a sudden threat toward a creature about to attack you that makes them flinch, throwing off their aim. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. This reaction can’t be triggered by the same creature again for 1 day.

**Special** If you have [Intimidating Glare](/feat/intimidating-glare-player-core), when you use this feat, you can have it lose the [auditory](/trait/auditory) trait and gain the [visual](/trait/visual) trait.

descr:

Choose either the [_gale blast_](/spell/gale-blast-player-core-2) or [_spout_](/spell/spout-player-core-2) cantrip. You can cast the chosen spell as a primal [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2232) at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
